CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cache / Array Share Control gives every user share three explicit, mutually exclusive choices: Cache -> Array, Cache only, or Array only (which safely runs Mover first and verifies pools are clear, with an optional forced transfer for stubborn leftovers). It uses Unraid's native share-update interface, creates a timestamped backup before every batch, verifies every applied change, and can restore the most recent un-restored batch. This repository contains the single Cache / Array Share Control plugin.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/RayMunro/unraid-cache-array-share/issues
